notes.title: New update is here!!
notes.content:
We have been working on a new version for a while, and here it is!

We appreciate the feedback we received from the community. We like to listen to our customers, and improve our projects based on external opinions. It will be always important to us what you have to say.

We are grateful for your support and patience, and of course, for helping us to build a better studio. 
As a way of thanking you all, we offer a 30% DISCOUNT for a month.

In this update, you will find new content, optimized gameplay experience, new control settings, Death Counter in new challenging Platform Levels, 3 new skins and several fixes.

We hope you enjoy it.
